items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 is valid. All volumes (40–200 µL) go through p300 within its 20–300 µL range, and labware is loaded with the required labels. The simulator checks passed.
Every transfer uses new_tip='always', so each sample well gets a fresh tip. The tip_before_aspirate, no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end checks all passed.

All 13 steps appear in order with the right volumes, and the manual steps are recorded with protocol.comment. The 10x mixes are done with mix_after=(10, 40) at steps 1 and 11, and the task gives no mix volume.
p300.transfer(40, beads, samples, mix_after=(10, 40), new_tip='always') does the bead addition and mixing. The 5 min incubation is recorded by comment before the magnet comment.
The magnet-engage and wait comment comes first. Then 90 µL goes from each well to waste, followed by two 200 µL ethanol adds, each followed by a 200 µL removal to waste.
Comments record the 5 min dry, magnet disengage, and the 2 min incubation with magnet re-engage. The 50 µL water is added with mix_after 10 times.
p300.transfer(45, samples, eluates, new_tip='always') pairs the wells in order, so sample identity is preserved. The end_state:elution_plate check passed.

judge.summary: The protocol follows all 13 steps with correct volumes, pipette choice, fresh tips per well, and comments for the unsimulated steps. All measured checks passed and I found no deviations.
